title: Guaranteed Resale Program Appraisal Fee: Desk Posting Card — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Resident desk card — the appraisal fee on a Guaranteed Resale Program file.** On the In-Place Home Resale Guaranteed Resale Program, the guarantee requires an independent appraisal before the home is listed, and that appraisal is charged to the seller once, against the appraisal record it bills, dated on that appraisal's record date. An older appraisal redone at Hearthstone's cost before the guaranteed offer carries no charge to the seller.

**Effect of posting.** One posting adds one appraisal-fee charge to the file's ledger, tied to the appraisal record it bills and dated as given, and raises the fees the seller owes on the file by the amount. The seller sees the appraisal fee among the file's charges and a higher fees-owed figure.

## Invocation

The desk tool is `post_appraisal_fee_5faa8f88`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resale_id` | the resale file number of the home being sold, as shown on the seller's resale file in the in-place resale file lookup | identifier text |
| `appraisal_record_id` | the reference number of the appraisal record being billed, as listed among the file's records in the resale record lookup | identifier text |
| `charge_date` | the date the charge is dated on the file | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time part and no time zone |
| `amount` | the appraisal fee charged, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; stored exactly as passed |

## Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of these fields: `status` (the text "posted"), `resale_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger charge), `resale_id` (the file charged), `charge_type` (always "appraisal_fee"), `source_entry_id` (the appraisal record the charge is tied to), `entry_date` (the charge date, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the charge in USD with 2 decimal places) and `fees_balance` (the fees owed on the file including this charge, USD with 2 decimal places). The tool defines no other receipt.

## Questions on the card

**How many appraisal fees does one appraisal record carry?** One: the appraisal is charged once, against the record it bills.

**Which date does the charge carry?** The record date of the appraisal it bills.

**Does an appraisal redone at Hearthstone's cost before the guaranteed offer carry a fee to the seller?** No.
